_comment: The single place to change company facts. Every legal document is
generated from these values by scripts/build_legal.py, so a change here
updates all of them at once and nothing drifts out of sync.
Anything still reading TODO must be filled before these documents are
TODO remains, so an unfinished policy cannot ship by accident.
COMPANY_LEGAL_NAME: TODO — the registered entity name, e.g. 'Acme Analytics Private Limited'
GRIEVANCE_OFFICER_NAME: TODO — required under Indian IT Rules; a named person
JURISDICTION_CITY: TODO — the courts of which city, e.g. 'Bengaluru'
HOSTING_PROVIDER: TODO — where the service runs, e.g. 'Amazon Web Services (ap-south-1, Mumbai)'
DATA_LOCATION: TODO — country/region where customer data is stored
LLM_PROVIDER: TODO — the configured AI provider, or 'none (offline mode)'
RETENTION_AUDIT_DAYS: TODO — the value actually configured, or 'retained until the account is deleted'
RETENTION_DATA_DAYS: TODO — the value actually configured, or 'retained until the customer deletes it'
TRIAL_DAYS: TODO — free trial length, or 'no free trial'
EFFECTIVE_DATE: TODO — the date these take effect, e.g. '1 September 2026'
